notes: The LCC application asks for a Social Security Number. The page says it is needed for financial aid after you graduate high school.
name: High School Dual Enrollment at Lansing Community College
what_you_do: Take regular college classes with LCC students while you finish high school and earn college credit. Homeschool students can take part too.
who_can_apply: Students working toward a high school diploma who finished 8th grade before their first college class. Homeschool students can apply.
pay_detail: Cost not stated. The page says many school districts cover some or all of the tuition, and homeschool students may self-pay.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the page read. Dual enrollment information sessions are listed on the LCC site.
how_to_apply: Apply online as "High School Student (Age 14+)" or with your counselor. Turn on your account and set your placement levels. Hand in the Dual Enrollment Approval Form, signed by a parent and a counselor. Then go to orientation and sign the FERPA release.
